solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Advertising place that's nice to rent with meals

indicators.note: rent is the past participle of rend, so the words nice and to are torn apart and their letters rearranged

parts.note: board means meals provided, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: A notice offering a room to let with meals included, pinned up somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' reads as letting a room, but here it means torn: NICE TO is rearranged to begin the answer, and board means meals, as in bed and board.
explanation.definitionFit: A noticeboard is a panel where adverts and announcements are pinned up for public view.

clue.text: Many mourn EU's abandonment

indicators.note: abandonment suggests wild, unrestrained disorder, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Lots of people grieve over Brexit, Britain leaving the European Union.
explanation.definitionFit: Numerous means great in number, so it stands for many.

clue.text: Stick up flier about party's last resolution

indicators.note: about means around, so the bird surrounds the reversed stick

parts.note: a tit is a small bird

indicators.note: in a down clue up means written from bottom to top

parts.note: a cane is a stick

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is taken

parts.note: its final letter

explanation.surface: Putting up a bird poster at a party at the end of a stubborn effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution in the sense of determination; tenacity is firm persistence.

clue.text: Show off name on trophy

parts.note: to crow is to boast or show off

explanation.surface: Boasting about one's name engraved on a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: A crown is a championship title, the prize a winner holds.

clue.text: Silence worker caught by exit injecting drug

definitions.note: used as a command, an imperative like the answer

indicators.note: caught in the sense of heard, so the word for worker is given by how it sounds

parts.note: a worker bee, the commonest crossword worker, said aloud

indicators.note: injecting means putting a dose into something, so the drug goes inside the word for exit

parts.note: to quit is to leave or exit
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A worker is caught leaving after injecting drugs and told to stay quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught' reads as arrested, but here it means heard: BEE sounds like BE. The setter has the exit take in the drug, an unusual direction for 'injecting'.
explanation.definitionFit: The command to be quiet is an order to stop talking, the same as the imperative silence.

clue.text: See a soldier long to advance to the front quickly

indicators.note: the phrase says the soldier pieces move ahead, so they come before the see rather than after it

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for long
Ely is a cathedral city, the seat of a bishop's see

explanation.surface: A soldier is urged to march forward to the front line quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, so it is a bishop's see; the clue names it first but A GI L goes ahead of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Agilely means nimbly and swiftly, moving with ease and speed.

clue.text: Realised struggling to comprehend book is worthwhile

indicators.note: to comprehend is to include, so the rearranged letters contain the extra one
struggling suggests the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone discovers that grappling with a difficult book has been worth it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something desirable is worth having, so it is worthwhile.

clue.text: Standard knock-back

indicators.note: back says the word for a knock is read from right to left

parts.note: a rap is a sharp knock

explanation.surface: A rejection is quite normal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knock-back' looks like one word meaning a rejection; split it, and the knock is turned back.
explanation.definitionFit: Par is the normal or expected level, as in up to par.

clue.text: Point about sport's to inspire

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the point abbreviation wraps the frolic

parts.note: to sport is to romp or frolic

explanation.surface: A coach explains how playing games motivates people.
explanation.definitionFit: To prompt someone is to move or spur them to act.

clue.text: Live on the edge

parts.note: re means on, in the sense of concerning
a side is an edge or border

explanation.surface: Living dangerously, on the edge.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside somewhere is to dwell there as one's home.

clue.text: Tropical fruit has chap needing to use the toilet

parts.note: a chap is a man
to go is an informal way of saying to use the toilet

explanation.surface: A man eating tropical fruit suddenly needs the bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: The mango is a sweet fleshy fruit grown in tropical regions.

clue.text: Queen has ultimate in Armani pince-nez spectacles for programmes like Pointless

indicators.note: ultimate means last, so the final letter of each of the two following words is taken

parts.note: its last letter
its last letter
spectacles are grand displays or shows

explanation.surface: The Queen sporting designer Armani pince-nez, perhaps while watching television.
explanation.walkthrough: Pointless is a long-running BBC television quiz in which contestants aim for the most obscure correct answers.
explanation.definitionFit: Pointless is an example of a televised general-knowledge contest, so the definition works by example.

clue.text: Make peace with cleric on unorthodox point

indicators.note: unorthodox describes something done in an irregular way, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: E (east) is one of the compass points

explanation.surface: Settling a quarrel with a priest who holds unconventional views.
explanation.definitionFit: To reconcile with someone is to restore friendly relations after a dispute.

clue.text: Swift to blame retired detective

parts.note: a rap is blame or punishment, as in take the rap

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

explanation.surface: A quick verdict blaming a detective who has stopped working.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something happening at great speed.

clue.text: Anxious and put out by endless fights

indicators.note: out means not in its proper place, so the three letters are rearranged
endless means the word loses both its first and its last letter

parts.note: the word as written, before its ends go

explanation.surface: Someone stressed and upset by an unending series of rows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' looks like a phrase meaning annoyed, part of the definition; here 'out' rearranges PUT into UPT.
explanation.definitionFit: Uptight is informal for tense and nervous, unable to relax.

clue.text: One who's prepared to arrange help for traveller?

parts.note: a Guide is a member of the Girl Guides, whose motto is Be Prepared
to book is to arrange in advance

explanation.surface: Someone ready to organise assistance for a tourist.
explanation.walkthrough: The Girl Guides are a youth movement, the counterpart of the Scouts, with the motto Be Prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: A guidebook is a handbook giving visitors information about a place.

clue.text: Some angrily observe hooligans…

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Bystanders glaring crossly at a gang of troublemakers.
explanation.definitionFit: Yob is British slang for a rowdy, aggressive young lout.

clue.text: Opening eastern border crossing's urgent

indicators.note: crossing is, i.e. straddling, so the opening sits on either side of the other pieces

parts.note: a vent is an opening
a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: A frontier crossing to the east is said to be pressing business.
explanation.definitionFit: Vehement means forceful and intense, insistently pressing a point.

clue.text: Half of menu has fat taken out with about a quarter suitable for vegetarians

indicators.note: half of means only the first two of the word's four letters are kept, its back half dropped

parts.note: its front half, the first two of four letters

indicators.note: taken out suggests the letters are disturbed and rearranged

parts.note: re means about, concerning
E (east) is a quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: Half the dishes have the fat removed so that vegetarians can eat them.
explanation.definitionFit: A meat-free dish contains no animal flesh, so non-carnivores can eat it.

clue.text: …beginning to make insults very loudly to offend

indicators.note: the beginning of each of the next two words is taken, their opening letter

parts.note: its first letter
its first letter
ff (fortissimo) is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Continuing from the previous clue: the hooligans start shouting abuse loudly to give offence.
explanation.definitionFit: To miff someone is an informal way of saying to annoy or put them out.

clue.text: Shop has fine catalogue you're regularly immersed in

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: immersed in means sunk inside, so the picked letters go within the list

parts.note: a list is a catalogue

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter, here the second and fourth

explanation.surface: A store offers a good brochure that customers can study closely.
explanation.walkthrough: Shop is fair because the florist's is the shop, and the shopkeeper is called the florist.
explanation.definitionFit: A florist is a seller of cut flowers, and the name is used for the shop itself.

clue.text: Luke and Lee played an instrument

indicators.note: played suggests the letters are toyed with and rearranged

explanation.surface: Two musicians called Luke and Lee performing on a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: UKELELE is an accepted variant spelling of ukulele.
explanation.definitionFit: The ukelele is a small four-stringed guitar-like instrument from Hawaii.

clue.text: Discover parameters of unknown planet

indicators.note: parameters suggests the limits, so the outside letters of the word are used

parts.note: its first and last letters
Earth is a planet

explanation.surface: Astronomers find an unidentified planet's dimensions.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth something is to dig it up or bring it to light.

clue.text: Clash with leader of group working with specialist language

parts.note: to jar is to clash, as colours jar

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word

parts.note: its first letter
on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: A dispute with the head of a team over technical terminology.
explanation.definitionFit: Jargon is the technical vocabulary of a profession, hard for outsiders to follow.

clue.text: European nobleman's unknown in part of the UK

parts.note: a count is a continental nobleman
Y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A mysterious foreign aristocrat living somewhere in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A county is an administrative region of Britain or Ireland.

clue.text: Love to read new 'Time Out'

indicators.note: new signals that the remaining letters form a fresh arrangement
Out says the named letter is dropped from the fodder before rearranging

explanation.surface: Wanting to read the latest edition of the listings magazine Time Out.
explanation.walkthrough: Time Out is a London listings magazine. Take T from TO READ to leave OREAD, then rearrange those letters as 'new' directs.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to love them deeply.

clue.text: Work too hard on cross in turned oak

parts.note: over can mean on top of, so on gives over

indicators.note: in says the cross is placed inside the tree
turned means read the other way round

parts.note: an oak is a tree
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A woodworker labouring too hard on a cross carved from oak on a lathe.
explanation.definitionFit: To overexert oneself is to strain beyond one's strength through excessive effort.

clue.text: Put away final volume in neat order

indicators.note: final means the last letter of the word

parts.note: its last letter

indicators.note: order means the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Shelving the last volume of a set tidily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put away' reads as storing, but it is slang for eating: consumed food has been put away.
explanation.definitionFit: To put away food is to eat it heartily, so the past participle is consumed.

clue.text: Boatman who's dying welcomes lido trip

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a goner is someone about to die

indicators.note: a trip is a stumble, so the letters of lido fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A dying man is happy to be taken on an outing to an open-air pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A gondolier is the man who rows a gondola on the Venetian canals.

clue.text: Finally get Irish to pursue return of what belongs to them

definitions.note: a phrase standing for the possessive adjective, of them

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word get
return of says the word for what is turned round

parts.note: eh? is an exclamation meaning what? when someone has not heard

explanation.surface: Someone is finally going after the Irish to claim back their property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'what' reads as the start of the definition, but it is the puzzled exclamation 'eh?', meaning 'what?'; the definition is only 'belongs to them'.
explanation.definitionFit: Their is the possessive adjective used for something owned by a group of people.

clue.text: Old negative of central Manhattan in New York

indicators.note: in places the middle letter inside the abbreviation
central means the single letter in the very middle of the word

parts.note: its middle letter, fifth of nine

explanation.surface: An old refusal heard in the middle of Manhattan, New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Nay is an archaic way of saying no.

clue.text: Revolutionary cutting equipment mostly made for a small cooking space

indicators.note: cutting means slicing into, so the revolutionary goes inside the other letters

parts.note: kit is equipment

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter

parts.note: netted means made, as in earned a profit
Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary

explanation.surface: A rebel slicing through gear made to fit a tiny kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchenette is a compact kitchen or cooking area, often in a flat.
